annotations.title: Set a payer follow-up's status webhook

description: Set the follow-up's webhook address with the account ID and the access token (the same as PUT /v1/payer-follow-ups/{id}/webhook). url: HTTPS on a public host (port 443 or 8443; no private, loopback, link-local or local addresses), at most 300 characters. Each time an application's status changes, that address gets a signed POST. Returns url, updated_at and a new secret, shown only in this reply; the previous secret stops signing at once. Every event carries a Licium-Signature header: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" keyed with the secret>.

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

url.description: The HTTPS address status events go to.

name: payer_follow_up_webhook_set
title: Set a payer follow-up's status webhook
